patthana24.17:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo hetu ceva sahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na hetuñceva na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo hetu ceva sahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve. na saraṇaṃ
patthana24.17:2.1: na sahetukañceva na na hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sahetuko ceva na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na ahetukañceva na na hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo sahetuko ceva naca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve. (hetu ceva hetusampayutta dukaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ.) na saraṇaṃ na hetuṃ
